name: Alpha-endorphin
summary: α-Endorphin (alpha-endorphin) is an endogenous opioid peptide with a length of 16 amino acids, and the amino acid sequence: Tyr-Gly-Gly-Phe-Met-Thr-Ser-Glu-Lys-Ser-Gln-Thr-Pro-Leu-Val-Thr. Researchers at the Salk Institute were pioneers in isolating, sequencing, and synthesizing the peptides they named α- and γ-endorphin, and they determined that they had morphinomimetic activity.

pharmacology.en: It is a short chain of amino acids made in the body from a larger precursor protein. It acts on opioid receptors, the same targets as morphine, which is why it is described as having morphine-like activity.
pharmacology.zh: 它是體內由較大前驅蛋白切下的短胺基酸鏈。它作用於鴉片受體，也就是嗎啡的作用標的，因此被形容為具有類嗎啡活性。
pharmacology.zhHans: 它是体内由较大前驱蛋白切下的短胺基酸链。它作用于鸦片受体，也就是吗啡的作用标的，因此被形容为具有类吗啡活性。

uses.en: It is not a medicine. It is studied in the laboratory to understand how the body's own opioid system works.
uses.zh: 它不是藥物，而是實驗室研究的對象，用來了解身體自身鴉片系統的運作方式。
uses.zhHans: 它不是药物，而是实验室研究的对象，用来了解身体自身鸦片系统的运作方式。

fact.en: The word endorphin is a blend of endogenous and morphine, meaning the body's own morphine. Alpha-endorphin was isolated and named by researchers at the Salk Institute in the 1970s.
fact.zh: endorphin（內啡肽）一詞由「內生的」與「嗎啡」合成，意思是身體自己的嗎啡。Alpha-endorphin 是 1970 年代索爾克研究所的研究人員分離並命名的。
fact.zhHans: endorphin（内啡肽）一词由「内生的」与「吗啡」合成，意思是身体自己的吗啡。Alpha-endorphin 是 1970 年代索尔克研究所的研究人员分离并命名的。
